brief: Identify concentration risk when several holdings depend on the same source of income.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Shared Exposure"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Nombres distintos, riesgo común"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Nomes diferentes, risco comum"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify concentration risk when several holdings depend on the same source of income.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Several investments can all depend on the same source of income.
instruction.misconception: Counting account names or securities proves diversification without examining their exposures.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Hotel shares and an airport business both depend on tourism. A travel collapse can hurt both despite different names.
Both businesses depend on travel demand.
Different apps can hold the identical underlying investment.
One employer’s trouble could affect both income and investments.
Overlapping holdings can preserve concentration across several funds.
Different industries can still share one geographic dependence.
One customer’s failure could damage both businesses.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: Several investments can all depend on the same source of income.

es-MX.line: Varias inversiones pueden depender de la misma fuente de ingresos.

pt-BR.line: Vários investimentos podem depender da mesma fonte de renda.

en-US.line: Hotel shares and an airport business both depend on tourism. A travel collapse can hurt both despite different names.

es-MX.line: Acciones de hoteles y un negocio aeroportuario dependen del turismo. Una caída de viajes puede afectar ambos pese a nombres distintos.

pt-BR.line: Ações de hotéis e um negócio aeroportuário dependem do turismo. Uma queda das viagens pode afetar ambos apesar dos nomes diferentes.

en-US.scene: A portfolio owns a resort and a cruise operator. Both rely on holiday travel.
help: Look through the names to their customers.

feedback.met: Both businesses depend on travel demand.
feedback.not_yet: Look through the names to their customers.

es-MX.scene: Una cartera tiene un hotel turístico y una operadora de cruceros. Ambos dependen de viajes vacacionales.
help: Mira sus clientes, no solo los nombres.

feedback.met: Ambos negocios dependen de la demanda de viajes.
feedback.not_yet: Mira sus clientes, no solo los nombres.

pt-BR.scene: Uma carteira tem um resort e uma operadora de cruzeiros. Ambos dependem de viagens de férias.
help: Observe os clientes, não só os nomes.

feedback.met: Ambos os negócios dependem da demanda por viagens.
feedback.not_yet: Observe os clientes, não só os nomes.

en-US.scene: Someone buys the same company’s shares through two different apps.

options.label: Yes, two apps mean two businesses

help: Inspect what is owned inside each account.

feedback.met: Different apps can hold the identical underlying investment.
feedback.not_yet: Inspect what is owned inside each account.

es-MX.scene: Alguien compra acciones de la misma empresa mediante dos aplicaciones.

options.label: Sí, dos aplicaciones son dos negocios
No, depende de la misma empresa

feedback.met: Aplicaciones distintas pueden guardar la misma inversión.

options.label: Sim, dois aplicativos são dois negócios

help: Confira o que cada conta possui.

feedback.met: Aplicativos diferentes podem guardar o mesmo investimento.
feedback.not_yet: Confira o que cada conta possui.

en-US.scene: A worker’s income and almost all investments depend on the same employer.
help: Consider linked risks beyond the investment account.

feedback.met: One employer’s trouble could affect both income and investments.
feedback.not_yet: Consider linked risks beyond the investment account.

es-MX.scene: El ingreso laboral y casi todas las inversiones dependen del mismo empleador.
help: Considera riesgos conectados fuera de la cuenta de inversión.

feedback.met: Problemas del empleador podrían afectar ingresos e inversiones.
feedback.not_yet: Considera riesgos conectados fuera de la cuenta de inversión.

pt-BR.scene: A renda do trabalho e quase todos os investimentos dependem do mesmo empregador.
help: Considere riscos ligados fora da conta de investimentos.

feedback.not_yet: Considere riscos ligados fora da conta de investimentos.

en-US.scene: Three differently named funds may hold many of the same companies.
help: Count distinct exposures, not product labels.

feedback.met: Overlapping holdings can preserve concentration across several funds.
feedback.not_yet: Count distinct exposures, not product labels.

es-MX.scene: Tres fondos con nombres distintos podrían tener muchas de las mismas empresas.

feedback.met: Coincidir en inversiones puede mantener la concentración entre fondos.

pt-BR.scene: Três fundos com nomes diferentes podem ter muitas das mesmas empresas.

feedback.met: Investimentos coincidentes podem manter concentração entre fundos.

en-US.scene: A portfolio holds several unrelated industries, but all revenue comes from one small town.

feedback.met: Different industries can still share one geographic dependence.
feedback.not_yet: Look for more than one source of concentration.

feedback.not_yet: Busca más de una fuente de concentración.

pt-BR.scene: Uma carteira tem setores diferentes, mas toda receita vem de uma cidade pequena.

feedback.not_yet: Procure mais de uma fonte de concentração.

en-US.scene: A delivery business and a packaging supplier earn nearly everything from the same retailer.
help: Follow the revenue source behind each business.

feedback.met: One customer’s failure could damage both businesses.
feedback.not_yet: Follow the revenue source behind each business.

help: Sigue la fuente de ingresos de cada negocio.

feedback.not_yet: Sigue la fuente de ingresos de cada negocio.

pt-BR.scene: Uma transportadora e um fornecedor de embalagens recebem quase toda receita da mesma loja.
